verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's chat docs say developers can ask follow-up questions, request clarifications, challenge recommendations, and explore alternatives in conversation on its PR feedback. A documented set of @coderabbitai commands covers reviews, pausing, resolving comments, and summaries, and preferences taught in chat carry into future reviews. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-thread conversational experience and its answer quality.
